subject: stepwiseqtl LOD scores and fitqtl LOD scores

messages.author: 9f052df81c7295a7
messages.subject: stepwiseqtl LOD scores and fitqtl LOD scores
parts:
Hello,

I have 374 haploid individuals genotyped with 1000 markers.

When I run stepwiseqtl, it gives 15 significant QTL. The LOD scores are roughly from 5 to 18.

Then I run makeqtl using the formula from stepwiseqtl and then run fitqtl.

fitqtl returns the LOD scores of the 15 QTL in a "Drop on QTL at a time ANOVA table" , but their LOD scores are much lower (2 to 10) than the stepwiseqtl LOD scores.

Can stepwiseqtl LOD scores and fitqtl LOD scores differ much?

Thank you very much for your attention,

YoshiM

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] stepwiseqtl LOD scores and fitqtl LOD scores
parts:
stepwiseqtl() doesn’t give LOD scores for individual QTL, unless you’re talking about the change in penalized LOD scores during the course of the forward selection phase. But those concern comparisons between models with say k and k+1 QTLs, while the drop-one-QTL lod scores from fitqtl are for comparisons of the full model and the model with just the given qtl removed. But these will generally be quite different. Another difference will be the refinement of QTL positions after a QTL term is added or removed.

But it should be that none of the drop-one-qtl lod curves are less than the main effect penalty you are using.

karl
